name: langguard-arbiter
description: LangGuard Arbiter — one hooks.json for Cursor: OpenTelemetry activity export plus in-harness policy. Screens, enforces, and evidences every MCP tool call against your LangGuard policies at the pre-action seam (beforeMCPExecution). Deterministic ALLOW / DENY / ASK — ASK surfaces as Cursor's native Ask approval prompt. Native shell gets a best-effort catastrophic-command deny (beforeShellExecution); afterMCPExecution and stop are advisory. Session, tool, file, and prompt events export as OTLP spans. No LLM in the enforcement loop. Disclosure: the bundled hook shim spawns a local background policy daemon (a private Unix socket in ~/.config/arbiter/run on macOS and Linux, TCP 127.0.0.1:52746 on Windows; shared with the LangGuard Codex and Antigravity plugins); policy logic stays server-side in your LangGuard tenant.
